snippet.title: Algoremind 🤖 🎮 Play FREE DEMO Steam Next Fest Oct 13–20 🎉 Add Wishlist and join the journey ✨
snippet.description:
Algoremind 🤖 🎮 Play the FREE DEMO during Steam Next Fest (Oct 13–20)! 🎉
⚡ Steam Next Fest starts October 13! 🚀

🎮 Play the FREE DEMO during Steam Next Fest (Oct 13–20)!
🎉 Add Algoremind to your Wishlist and join the journey! ✨
👾 Early Access launches October 24!

Algoremind 🤖 — a solo-dev pixel RPG where you shape your own AI, survive across 3 unique worlds, and unlock permanent rewards with every ending.

🗺️ Biome Diversity
🌃 Cysooth • 🌸 Viochiru • ❄️ Criwhielsk
(2 of them available in the demo)

🍞 Survival & Needs Bar System
Manage your hunger, stamina, and mood to survive long exploration days — every choice affects your mind and efficiency.

⚔️ Monster & Boss Combat
Battle adaptive creatures and biome bosses with unique behaviors and attack patterns.

🕯️ Cozy Sci-Fi RPG Atmosphere
A fusion of warm lighting, ambient soundscapes, and futuristic ruins — where serenity meets mystery.

🧩 Skill Stations & AI Interaction
Unlock new abilities and communicate with AI created by you !

🗝️ Resource Crafting & Base Building
Gather materials, craft tools, and expand your base to survive longer and evolve.

🎵 Immersive Synthwave & Lo-Fi Soundtrack
Experience evolving emotional synth and Lo-Fi melodies that adapt to your journey.

📌 Your feedback means everything.
We truly appreciate your support as we work to bring Algoremind to its full release. 💫
